description.value:
Some claim a ‘sniper rocket launcher’ is excessive for Nomads to have. Others claim that such a weapon is too cumbersome or awkward for use in mobile warfare. Yet, nobody claims that Nokota’s Condor isn’t terrifying to oppose — because a near-silent rocket with the precision of a bullet is hard to complain about. Especially when it’s being fired by a pissed-off roadwarrior from the back of an armored pickup truck.

Cost: 2,300eb (Very Expensive)

Class: EQ Rocket Launcher • Skill: Heavy Weapons • Range: Sniper Rifle

Damage: 7d6 • Capacity: 2 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 2

Alt. Firing Modes: Explosive

Concealable: NoSlots: 0 • Attachments: Extended Magazine, Silencer, Sniping Scope • Mods: Payload Conversion Kit

Special Features: Explosives fired by this weapon only explode in a 6x6m/yds (3x3 Squares) area [Payload Conversion Kit]. This weapon’s Silencer only silences the initial launch of an Explosive, not its actual detonation [Payload Conversion Kit + Silencer].

Range: Sniper Rifle
Pre-installed: Extended Magazine, Silencer, Sniping Scope (effects already included in these stats)
Mods: Payload Conversion Kit
Alt. fire: Explosive

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
